title: Channel card: level
comments: SSI2162 dual VCA (datasheet Rev 1.2 Fig. 1), Class AB; R206 DNP (fit for Class A)
Fader law: 3-segment, 0 dB at 75 %, -113 dB at bottom; C224 gives 10 ms smoothing
MUTE: DG413 adds +4.5 V to VC; DUCK: SC_ENV, +1 V = 10 dB
VCA stage inverts, U203 inverts back: POSTFADE same polarity as POSTFILT
